label: Any being that is not composite, whose represented esse equals its represented…, from reception
description: Take a being with no represented limiting principle and suppose its esse is received in some principle r. If its represented esse equalled its essence, r would be that essence (STMT-IDENTITY-BEARERS-RECEIVE-ESSE-ONLY-IN-OWN-ESSENCE), r would be in receptive potency to the esse (STMT-RECEIVER-IN-POTENCY-TO-RECEIVED-ESSE, De ente c.3), so the essence would be in receptive potency to itself, which STMT-NOTHING-IN-RECEPTIVE-POTENCY-TO-ITSELF excludes; so its esse would differ from its essence, a limiting principle. Hence its esse is received in nothing, and by STMT-UNRECEIVED-ESSE-IS-OWN-BEING (q.7 a.1 with ad 3) it is its own being. Derives the former bare bridge STMT-UNLIMITED-IS-OWN-BEING. Only the esse/essence disjunct of the limiting-principle proxy is used; composition and priority play no role, and no excluded middle is used. The three reception premises are those of the designated infinity route SUBSISTENT-INFINITY-FROM-IDENTITY-SCOPED-RECEPTION; all four premises stay open.
